notes: AI may assist but final approval denial pricing and exception decisions remain human owned

risk_addressed: Exposure of sensitive personal or financial information
notes: PII and sensitive financial data must be classified before AI processing

notes: Used when small business lending data collection or reporting may apply

risk_addressed: Financial crime compliance gaps in borrower onboarding
notes: AI summaries cannot replace compliance analyst review

notes: Collateral property asset lien and insurance data must be verified

risk_addressed: Unclassified sensitive data used by analytics or AI workflows
notes: Governed credit data products require ownership classification and access rules

risk_addressed: AI output used without review or context
notes: Reviewer must attest that AI output was reviewed and not blindly accepted

risk_addressed: Insufficient evidence for approvals exceptions and control decisions
notes: Governance decisions must be retained for audit and monitoring
